instruction: Open the baby name details page for Carl on BabyCenter.

The single instruction requirement (open Carl's details page on BabyCenter) is fully covered by the URL pattern check — no partial coverage issues.
No postconfig is needed since URL state persists without requiring any dialog or UI to be reopened.
